items.heading: Koshari
details: Key ingredients: rice, lentils, macaroni, tomato sauce, fried onion
Cook rice, lentils and macaroni separately until tender.
Layer them together in a bowl.
Top with a spiced tomato sauce and crispy fried onions.
Mix everything together before eating.

items.heading: Ful Medames
details: Key ingredients: fava beans, garlic, lemon, olive oil, cumin
Simmer fava beans until very soft.
Mash lightly, leaving some texture.
Season with garlic, lemon juice, cumin and olive oil.
Serve warm with bread for scooping.

details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
